encoding: JSON document; validator $numberLong values use MongoDB Extended JSON and must be decoded as BSON long, never float.
authority: SRS v1.1; accepted ADR-01/02; original IAM-01/FND-03/FND-05/G-05 backlog. No institutional or deployment approval implied.
placement: Four additive application-MongoDB collections proposed for a later reviewed migration. Never auto-loaded; no modification of accepted v1 catalogue or fixture metadata.
scope: Durable registration admission/account activation only. No session, privilege, enrollment, verified academic identity, consent or certificate is issued.
design_choices: Use one immutable intent UUIDv4 as intent/activation-operation/proposed user UUID; no user document exists before final apply. Reusing this UUID across separate namespaces does not assign a System ID before registration.
System ID reservation is independent and idempotent by operation + intent fingerprint. A reserved ID may be abandoned but never freed/recycled. Mongo allocation rows are projections only.

Allocation state mirrors the independently verified issuer state/revision/receipt exactly. A successful local registration may therefore retain issuer state reserved; activation.state=applied records local account application separately. No issued transition is inferred from account commit. This requires an irrevocable, non-expiring/non-reclaimable reservation binding to the original operation/user UUID; a leased/reusable reservation is not acceptable. Only a later independently authenticated issuer acknowledgment can advance projection to issued or retired.
Claiming OTP and recording a durable original claim/allocation command are one Mongo transaction. Directly calling the existing boolean verifier then creating a user is forbidden.

An operation-bound independently authenticated activation decision must close the approval-change race; a boolean approval lookup or short TTL alone cannot serialize legal admission with an external authority.

Dedicated registration challenges are an explicit proposed divergence from the original backlog auth_challenges mapping; accepted general auth_challenges remains untouched. No TTL until recovery/retention policy is approved.

Candidate numeric OTP input length 4-12 and attempt ceiling 10 preserve current prerequisite bounds, not institutional OTP settings. Lifetime, resend/processing deadlines, key custody and official ID format remain unselected.
interface_gaps_before_implementation: SystemIdIssuer currently returns SystemIdAllocation only (operation/fingerprint/ID/state/revision), not issuer proof/reference. Propose a verified reservation envelope/acknowledged port that binds those fields plus configured issuer namespace/generation and authenticates authority_ref/receipt_hash. Reservation is irrevocably bound/nonreusable even if its state remains reserved after local apply; no issue RPC/issued proof is invented. Preserve issuer state in the projection and local completion only in activation.state. Do not manufacture independent proof by hashing a local projection or silently relabel the existing value as an external receipt.

CurrentApprovalAuthority.confirms is preflight only. Proposed RegistrationActivationAuthority accepts original closed ActivationCommand and returns authenticated operation-bound allowed/rejected decision; lookup uses original operation and strict committed/noncommit/unknown semantics. No concrete provider or proof algorithm is selected.

Existing RegistrationChallengeRepository.consume returns bool without a transaction/session or durable claim; it cannot implement claim+operation atomicity. Add a transaction-owned claim adapter, preserving the prerequisite primitive until the new contract/metadata is accepted.

RegistrationIntent has no persistence export; add a versioned server-only envelope codec with closed decrypt validation rather than public plaintext JSON serialization. Test byte-stable fingerprints/child IDs and redacted debug/exception paths.

fields: intent (all validated RegistrationIntent fields; passwordHash optional/null and server-generated only)
intent.binding: Canonical plaintext hash = sealed_payload_hash; authenticated ciphertext wrapper binds collection, intent UUID, intent_fingerprint and payload hash. Validate exact plaintext shape after decrypt. No raw password.

fields: stable UUIDs: emailId, optional credentialId, termsAckId, privacyAckId, auditId, journalId
claim.binding: Generate stable child IDs exactly once in the claim transaction; hash canonical body into claim_fingerprint. No raw OTP or mail/password secret.

fields: original closed claim body including stable child IDs (no raw OTP/password/email)
activation_command.binding: Persist exact canonical encrypted command before external submission; command_fingerprint excludes transport encryption randomness. Never generate new child IDs/body on retry. Independent lookup must recover original canonical command/receipt; if original sealed intent payload or keys are lost, hashes cannot reconstruct them and automatic completion stays fenced.

protocol.guard: Current G-05 exact notice bundle; technical readiness; reviewed global recipient/IP throttling and delivery policy.
protocol.atomicMongo: Store immutable encrypted pending intent and current challenge before any approved delivery handoff. No users, credentials, sessions or grants.
protocol.retry: Start idempotency requires a separately reviewed optional header if added; multiple intents cannot bypass current verified-email uniqueness at apply. Generic Challenge response must not enumerate accounts.

protocol.guard: Current notices/approval; pending intent exact ciphertext hash; current challenge/purpose/recipient/intent MAC; DB-clock expiry and bounded attempts.
protocol.atomicMongo: One snapshot/primary/majority transaction increments attempt, consumes only correct code, sets is_current=false and claim_operation_id, CASes pending->claimed, and inserts original activation claim. Wrong code commits its attempt without claim/user; aborted transaction consumes nothing.
protocol.retry: Existing consumed claim can resume only from its original durable operation AND trusted independent current/recovery evidence; never from the supplied OTP or restored local consumed flag alone.

protocol.guard: Verified durable claim; trusted independently current SystemIdIssuer; original processing deadline for a new decision.
protocol.atomicMongo: After independently acknowledged reserve(original operation, original intent fingerprint), CAS claimed->prepared with exact reserved ID/reference and encrypted original activation command. No account or session yet.
protocol.retry: Lost reserve ACK: authenticated lookup/retry SAME issuer operation. Restored/absent local projection is not proof an ID is free. Lost prepare ACK: read/reconcile exact original body, never overwrite conflicts.

protocol.guard: Proposed RegistrationActivationAuthority.verify-and-decide(original command) serializes current notices/approval and identity/account-recovery fences at its own authoritative ordering point.
protocol.atomicMongo: No transaction spans network. Keep prepared local command while independent result is unknown. Authenticated decision receipt binds every original fingerprint, reserved ID, operation and configured issuer generation.
protocol.retry: Authenticated lookup original operation returns committed allowed/rejected, authenticated noncommit or unknown. Unknown/offline/mismatched/expired-before-new-admission stays fenced. Historical admission receipt never supplies current positive authorization.

protocol.guard: Verify original decision receipt AND independently current recovery/admission/issuer state. Current issuer proof must retain the same operation/fingerprint/ID and be non-retired; a later retirement blocks new account application even with an old admission receipt. Local duplicate email/user/ID/binding conflicts cannot be repaired by attaching to someone else.
protocol.atomicMongo: Allowed: one snapshot/primary/majority transaction creates exact users + verified primary personal email + optional credential + two historical notice acknowledgments + redacted audit/security journal, stores the independently verified current allocation proof without synthesizing state/revision/receipt, and marks activation applied and intent activated. Rejected: atomically mark denied + redacted audit, no users/credentials/sessions. Require exact immutable bodies on retry and authenticated monotone issuer projection reconciliation; no upsert into unrelated records.
protocol.retry: Lost commit ACK: reconcile original operation/current authority and all immutable mapped records. Local applied status never implies issuer state issued; lookup/reuse of the same irrevocable reservation is sufficient, not a new issue command. If issuer state later legitimately advances, preserve the original reservation in the encrypted original command and accept only a verified monotone latest projection. Missing/partial data or changed credentials/account state does not imply noncommit or permission to recreate/reset. Never downgrade a later disabled/recovered account.

application_guards_not_proven_by_schema: Digest/MAC binary length 32, authenticated encryption, decoded payload/command closed shapes and fingerprints must be checked in application; binData shape alone is insufficient. Pin bounded canonical plaintext (existing 16KiB authority envelope limit) and reviewed ciphertext/body limits before implementation.

recipient_key_id identifies the pinned recipient-HMAC key independently of payload/OTP verification keys. Rotation must preserve pending bindings and cross-key abuse accounting rather than resetting limits; unknown keys deny.

All referenced IDs/notice stored objects/current versions and content hashes, provisional program/department/year/classification are server-resolved. Do not write an authorized program_assignment or verified student_identifier from self-selection.

CAS every state/revision update and guard BSON-long exhaustion; allowed local transitions pending->claimed->activated|denied, activation claimed->prepared->applied|denied. Allocation state/revision is copied only from verified current issuer proof with no backwards/free transition; final account apply does not cause reserved->issued. Reserved can remain permanently bound; later issued/retired requires its own authenticated issuer acknowledgment, not a local fabrication.

Resend atomically supersedes the old current challenge only while intent pending; it cannot clear global attempt/rate policy or reset a claimed operation. Revisions must invalidate stale concurrent resend/claim.

No raw OTP/password in persisted intent/commands, background_jobs.payload_redacted, audit, URLs, argv or exceptions. Approved encrypted short-lived delivery handoff/outbox belongs to FND-04 and is not provided by this proposal.

After any local restore, do not trust applied/consumed/issued flags or local unique indexes as independent truth. Require trusted current account/registration/issuer recovery evidence; unavailable default denies.

Existing general auth_challenges, test-only prerequisite collections, accepted 62-collection catalogue, active unavailable providers and public routes remain unchanged until a separately approved implementation.

api_mapping.POST /api/v1/auth/registrations: Existing 200 Challenge envelope, generic anti-enumeration. Durable delivery handoff acknowledgment means scheduled, not delivered; only a reviewed actual delivery outcome can be reported as delivery.
api_mapping.POST /api/v1/auth/email-verifications: 200 SelfUser only after exact final account commit and permitted current recovery state. No session/cookie authentication implicitly follows.
api_mapping.pending_or_unknown: Existing proposed 503 Problem with stable correlation, not a new 202 body or false success. 409 for binding/uniqueness conflict without disclosing other accounts. Public retry is not lookup-by-challengeId: require still-valid possession proof under reviewed limits or an approved secret resume capability, plus independent current recovery evidence. Returning an exact prior result is not a second OTP consumption or new authentication; expired proof gets no public account result. Internal recovery can reconcile an acknowledged original without authorizing its caller.
api_mapping.dto_review_required: RegisterInput lacks department/year despite FR-ID-001. Propose reviewed optional additive request fields plus server catalogue validation; do not silently require unversioned new fields or invent verified academic data. Staff SelfUser.systemId and CSRF/uncertainty mappings remain separate contract-review items.

failure_matrix.claim transaction abort: No consumption/user/command; wrong-attempt rollback has no grant; outer rate limiting still applies.
failure_matrix.claim commit ACK lost: Find same claim/intent and reconcile before any issuer call; never new UUID/OTP-only completion from local restored state.
failure_matrix.issuer ACK or prepare commit ACK lost: Lookup same operation; keep reserved IDs burned and original allocation binding; unknown fences.
failure_matrix.local account committed while issuer rem: Valid only with independently durable irrevocable nonreusable binding. Keep projection reserved with the actual issuer receipt/revision; activation applied records local success. Lost local ACK reuses that same reservation, never fabricates issued or asks for another System ID.
failure_matrix.approval changes before independent deci: Decision rejects/holds old bundle; re-present approved material notice in a new immutable intent, never rewrite old evidence.
failure_matrix.notice changes after authoritative admis: Preserve exact admission ordering/history; current authority/material-change policy decides further processing, never infer perpetual consent or authorization from a past receipt.
failure_matrix.two intents race on verified email: Unique verified-email index permits one account; loser does not attach to winner/change its password. Reserved loser ID remains unavailable for reuse; retain repair evidence.
failure_matrix.local activation commit ACK lost: Read original operation/receipt and exact mapped bodies on primary; repair only under trusted current authoritative recovery rules.
failure_matrix.stale restore or newer recovery/deactiva: Historical receipt is not current permission; never overwrite security_epoch/password/revocation or regenerate a user from local absence alone.
failure_matrix.key unavailable/tampered payload/unknown: Refuse processing; no random key fallback, partial decode or automatic schema/index repair.

next_implementation_plan.work: Pin closed canonical claim/decision and acknowledged allocation bindings plus authenticated lookup semantics against server-trusted configuration; unavailable implementation remains default. Tests first: changed operation/notice/allocation/issuer, false currentness, unknown/forged/replayed decision, raw-secret redaction.

After schema approval, implement versioned additive migration in an expressly approved isolated target; validate exact metadata without collMod repair. Atomically claim+record original operation; failure/last-attempt/resend concurrency and lost-ACK tests before implementation. Do not modify current bool-verifier contract into a full activation result.

After independently trusted issuer/admission protocol and schema acceptance, coordinate original ID reserve/prepare/decision/final apply with safe lookup and exact immutable comparisons. Use synthetic records and no public routes; test duplicate email, false local restore, original-child-ID retry and later-recovery fences.

files: routes/api.php + registration controllers only after gates
next_implementation_plan.work: Complete policy/DTO/global-rate-limit/approved-notice/delivery work and real deployment acceptance before proposing route activation. No provider or institution approval is supplied by this artifact.

rollback: Before apply: remove proposal only after diff review. Future applied change: fence issuance/access, retain all claims/commands/receipts, ciphertext key access and burned/retired ID evidence; no drops, down cleanup or file-session fallback. Restore code/config only through separately reviewed compatibility/reauth/MFA plan.

implemented_wire_contracts_v1.status: Implemented as pure contracts with unavailable runtime authority; schemas, real provider and application remain gated.

RegistrationClaim.credentialId: Required member, UUID or null. Terms/privacy acknowledgment IDs must differ. operationId=intentId=userId.

AllocationReservation.revision: Canonical decimal string, 1..9223372036854775807; never JSON float.
AllocationReservation.verification: VerifiedAllocationReservation authenticates configured issuer, exact claim operation/user/intent fingerprint and causal time. Retired proof is history and cannot prepare a command. It does not establish current issuer state.

ActivationCommand.nested: Full closed claim and original signed allocation data. Factory takes verified allocation; parsed DTO still requires proof verification. Claim verification must precede allocation commit, which must precede preparedAt within the original claim window; enforced for factory and parsed commands. Persist/retry exact canonical command including original nested proof.

ActivationDecision.verification: VerifiedActivationDecision checks both configured allocation and admission proofs and every binding/fingerprint. allowed commit is before original exclusive deadline; rejected history may be later. Same original history can reverify; changed body/operation cannot.

VerifiedActivationAbsence.verification: Private construction after configured proof check, requested operation/nonce, historyComplete=true, and server lower/upper observation bounds. Absence at a point never permits a new operation or proves future noncommit.

RegistrationActivationAuthority.decide: decide(ActivationCommand): ActivationDecision (raw DTO requires configured verification)
RegistrationActivationAuthority.lookup: lookup(operation UUID, fresh server nonce): ActivationLookup
RegistrationActivationAuthority.default: UnavailableRegistrationActivationAuthority throws ActivationAuthorityUnavailable on decide; lookup yields unknown only.

ActivationLookup.construction: Private tagged union with private status/payload. notCommitted(operationId, expectedNonce, verifiedAbsence) checks operation and nonce. Every consumer must call resolveFor(operationId, expectedNonce, earliestCheck, latestCheck), which rechecks operation and challenged noncommit observation bounds even for a cached union. Committed historical decisions bind operation but do not imply fresh authorization. Neither status confirms current authorization or local account application.

implemented_wire_contracts_v1.canonicalization: Existing bounded 16KiB canonical JSON/JCS subset; exact closed schemaVersion=1, UUIDv4/digest/reference/time types; detached nested scalar snapshots. Top-level proof excluded from its own signed canonical body. Command fingerprint includes original nested proof. No key or secret choice from the wire.
implemented_wire_contracts_v1.clock_policy: Strict UTC millisecond causal/deadline ordering, no implicit skew allowance. Production clock/trust configuration must be accepted before a real adapter. Historical proof verification never replaces current recovery/admission/issuer checks.
